title: 2.15 ¡Nos vemos en el parque!
unit_title: Places, things and how we describe them
unit_outcome: Say where people go and how they get there, talk about the things people have, point things out and compare them, put things in order, and ask about favorites.
goal: Spend a day in the park with Ana's friends: find people by how they arrive, what they have, light and dark colors and -er than, find who breaks each park rule with Don't, find the truth in an isn't clue, and answer Ana's friends aloud about how she comes, her favorite color, where she lives and her rabbit's name.
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 2.15 Encuentro en el parque: A1 closes Unit 2 by meeting in the park; A1+ 2.15 closes A1+ Unit 2 with a day in the same kind of park and no new language. The learner finds people by how they arrive (2.1-2.2), what they have (2.3), light or dark colors (2.13) and -er than (2.11), finds who breaks each park rule with Don't (2.12, bringing back 1.3's swim), finds the camera from an isn't clue (2.4), and answers How do you go …?, What's your favorite color?, Where do you live? and What is its name? aloud for Ana (2.2, 2.8, 2.7, 1.10).
speaking_outcome: Answer four friends' questions aloud for Ana: how she comes to the park, her favorite color, which floor she lives on and the name of her rabbit.
